title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Episode 13 Preview Trailer and Images Revealed
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 13 (Episode 79 overall) preview ahead of its August 19, 2026 premiere. This will be the second episode of the second cour, which subtitled The Recapture Arc . A teaser trailer previously featured some of the scenes featured today as well.
author: Anime Corner

title: Takopi's Original Sin Movie Special Trailer Reveals November 27 Premiere
content: Takopi’s Original Sin -Thank You, See You Tomorrow- movie revealed a new trailer, as well as a November 27 premiere date for Japan. The anime originally ran from June 28 to August 1. It swept the weekly rankings every week during its run, taking five wins.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Skip to Loafer 2nd Season' Reveals New Staff, Second Teaser Promo
content: • The official website for the Skip to Loafer 2nd Season ( Skip and Loafer Season 2 ) television anime revealed new staff and a second teaser promotional video on Sunday. The second anime season adapting Misaki Takamatsu 's coming-of-age manga will premier in April 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Takopi's Original Sin Compilation Film's Video Unveils November 27 Debut
content: The official website for the anime of Taizan 5 's Takopi's Original Sin ( Takopii no Genzai ) manga began streaming a new "special video" for the anime's Takopii no Genzai -Arigatō, Mata Ashita- ( Takopi's Original Sin : Thank You, See You Tomorrow ) compilation film on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Liar Game Anime Adds 4 Cast Members
content: The official website for the television anime of Shinobu Kaitani 's Liar Game manga announced four new cast members for the anime on Tuesday. The new cast members are: Daisuke Namikawa as Solario, a dealer of the Liar Game Office. He oversees the next Revival Round held after Round 3 ends.
author: ANN

title: 3 Dragon Ball Z Villains Better Than Frieza
content: As one of the oldest and most iconic anime and manga franchises of all time, Akira Toriyama’s Dragon Ball has introduced us to a vast majority of incredible villains. The original manga was adapted into anime in two major parts: Dragon Ball and Dragon Ball Z .
author: ComicBook

title: 7 Years Later, Spy x Family Finally Teases Anya’s Past
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Spy x Family manga! Tatsuya Endo’s Spy x Family manga debuted in 2019 and features a heartwarming story centering around the Forger family. Loid Forger is a talented spy working for WISE, an organization in Westalis aiming to maintain the fragile peace with Ostania.
author: ComicBook

title: Dragon Ball Daima Returns With Its Final Release For U.S. Fans
content: Akira Toriyama’s final work, Dragon Ball Daima , reached its conclusion around the same time as his first death anniversary in February this year. The legendary mangaka worked on the story and character design before supervising the anime’s production, and it’s expected that the show would be well-received by fans.
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Years Later, Oshi no Ko Is All Set For Its Controversial Finale With a New Look
content: Aka Akasaka’s popular idol manga Oshi no Ko debuted its anime adaptation in 2023, and the second season was released just a year later. The manga was concluded with a highly controversial finale in 2024, but the anime has a lot of story left to cover.
author: ComicBook
